DUPLICATE_FOREIGN_KEY.description: More than one foreign-key constraint enforces the same column relationship.
DUPLICATE_FOREIGN_KEY.recommendation: Keep one canonical constraint and remove duplicates through a versioned migration.

ANNOTATION_DRIFT.description: An asset registered in Provider annotations is absent from the live source catalog.
ANNOTATION_DRIFT.recommendation: Check the source connection and rename mapping, or retire the stale annotation.

detail.HEALTHY: Services, domains, and company administrator configuration are all within normal bounds.
detail.ATTENTION: Review {{services}} service exceptions, {{domains}} unverified domains, and active administrator status.
detail.CRITICAL: Recover failed services first, then verify customer impact and execution evidence.

domains.title: Verified domains
domains.challengeNotice: Add the following TXT record with the DNS provider, then verify.

administrators.title: Company administrators
administrators.customerDeliveryRequired: Administrator activation is unavailable until a customer-owned out-of-band delivery channel is connected. Provider operators cannot issue or view activation links.

entitlements.catalogLoading: Loading the governed entitlement catalog. Tenant operational detail remains available.
entitlements.catalogUnavailable: The governed entitlement catalog is unavailable. Existing tenant state remains visible, but entitlement changes are disabled.

support.title: Tenant support sessions
support.restricted: Privileged support history requires dedicated support-ledger access.
support.loading: Loading the privileged support ledger. Other tenant detail remains available.
support.unavailable: The privileged support ledger is unavailable. Other tenant detail remains available.
support.empty: No support sessions exist for this tenant.

settingsResolution.title: Effective configuration and application state
settingsResolution.description: Inspect the desired state, current effective value, observed application state, and value provenance for each tenant.

catalog.denied: You do not have permission to read the configuration catalog.
catalog.error: The configuration catalog could not be loaded.
catalog.stale: The catalog refresh failed. The last confirmed entries remain visible.
catalog.emptyDescription: No configuration owner is readable with your current permissions, or no setting has been registered.

tenant.denied: Tenant estate access is unavailable, so no target-specific effective value was requested.
tenant.error: The tenant estate could not be loaded.
tenant.empty: No readable tenant is available for effective-value resolution.
tenant.searchHelp: Search the complete tenant estate by company, tenant name, or key.

effective.denied: You do not have permission to read this target's effective value.
effective.error: The target setting could not be resolved.
effective.valueUnavailable: The effective value cannot be displayed safely.

resolution.REDACTED: The effective value is redacted by sensitivity policy. Reason: {{reason}}
resolution.UNSUPPORTED_SETTING: This setting is unsupported or is not readable. Reason: {{reason}}
resolution.UNSUPPORTED_SCOPE: This setting does not support the selected scope. Reason: {{reason}}
resolution.VALUE_UNAVAILABLE: The effective value is currently unavailable. Reason: {{reason}}
resolution.UNAVAILABLE_STATE: The effective state cannot be displayed because the owner returned an unsupported status.

settingsResolution.observationUnsupported: The published effective value is known, but no application receipt connector is available for its runtime targets. This is not treated as applied.
settingsResolution.sampledGatewayObservation: Feature rollout evidence covers a sampled authoritative Gateway request path. It does not assert convergence across every Gateway replica.

provenance.title: Value provenance
provenance.description: Sources that participated in resolution are shown from highest to lowest precedence.
provenance.empty: No value provenance is available for display.

resolutionReason.SCOPE_NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_OWNER: Scope is not supported by the owner
resolutionReason.VALUE_REDACTED_BY_SENSITIVITY: Value is redacted by sensitivity policy

tenantExperiencePreview.title: Tenant experience configuration preview
tenantExperiencePreview.description: Inspect fixed tenant branding and home-experience configuration without opening a customer user session.

no-session.title: An approved diagnosis session is required
no-session.description: Start a time-bound session for this tenant with the explicit TENANT_EXPERIENCE_PREVIEW scope.

wrong-tenant.title: The active session targets another tenant
wrong-tenant.description: Configuration is withheld because the route tenant and active support target do not match.

expired.title: The diagnosis session has expired
expired.description: Configuration was closed at expiry. Start a new approved session if diagnosis must continue.

scope-denied.title: Configuration preview is outside the approved scope
scope-denied.description: The active session does not include TENANT_EXPERIENCE_PREVIEW. No tenant preview data was requested.

context-error.title: The diagnosis boundary could not be verified
context-error.description: Tenant configuration remains closed while the active session context is unavailable.

partialFailure.title: The complete configuration could not be verified
partialFailure.description: The preview is withheld because branding and home-experience configuration were not both loaded successfully.

boundary.title: Configuration-only synthetic preview
boundary.description: This fixed synthesis uses tenant-managed branding and home-experience settings only. It contains no personal widgets, work data, employee identity, or impersonated session.

canvas.label: Synthetic tenant experience configuration canvas
canvas.watermark: CONFIG ONLY · ASSETS REDACTED · NOT CUSTOMER UI
canvas.headlineFallback: Tenant home headline is not configured
canvas.subheadlineFallback: This fallback appears only in the provider configuration preview.

configuration.title: Published configuration summary
configuration.description: Static policy values are shown for diagnosis; no user entitlement or personalized layout is evaluated.
configuration.empty: No enabled launchpad groups are present in the published configuration.

resourceGovernance.boundary: Commitments and ledger entries are provider-owned internal evidence. They do not represent external usage, invoices, or a billing-system balance.
resourceGovernance.listPartial: Showing {{count}} records from the owner limit of {{limit}}. Additional commitments exist, so derived totals and all-clear conclusions are withheld.
resourceGovernance.commitmentGuidance: Propose a capacity or budget commitment for independent review. Contract changes require a published commercial renewal; temporary overrides expire automatically.
resourceGovernance.ledgerGuidance: Ledger rows are immutable internal evidence. Budget rows use CURRENCY_MINOR; metering never asserts an external usage feed.
resourceGovernance.tenantSelectionUnavailable: Changing a tenant commitment or recording its evidence needs estate-read access. View-only governance records remain available.
resourceGovernance.operatorLoading: Verifying the current provider operator and permissions.
resourceGovernance.operatorUnavailable: Operator permissions could not be verified. Governed actions remain disabled.
resourceGovernance.catalogLoading: Loading the complete tenant and published-renewal catalogs. Change actions remain disabled until coverage is verified.
resourceGovernance.tenantCatalogUnavailable: The complete tenant catalog is unavailable. Commitment changes remain disabled.
resourceGovernance.renewalCatalogUnavailable: Published commercial renewal evidence is unavailable. Commitment changes remain disabled.
resourceGovernance.completed: The internal governance record was saved.
resourceGovernance.resourceKeyHelp: Example: workspace.seats. Use lowercase keys with letters, numbers, dots, underscores, or hyphens.

validation.commitmentIdentity: Choose a tenant and enter a resource key.
validation.limit: Set at least one quota or budget limit.
validation.currency: Budget evidence requires the commitment currency.
validation.controlPeriod: The control period must end after it starts.
validation.justification: A business justification is required for independent review.
validation.commercialEvidence: Enter a valid published commercial renewal revision ID.
validation.overrideExpiry: A temporary override requires an expiry for an existing commitment.
validation.amount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
validation.ledgerEvidence: Evidence reference and reason are required.

metrics.commitmentsDetail: Tenant resource controls with durable limits.
metrics.activeDetail: Commitments that can receive internal evidence.
metrics.partialDetail: Unavailable because the owner list is incomplete.

resourceGovernance.inventoryDescription: Review tenant capacity and budget limits before recording immutable internal evidence.

empty.title: No resource commitments
empty.description: Create a tenant resource commitment to begin an internal evidence ledger.

resourceGovernance.ledgerDescription: Immutable allocation, release, metering, and budget evidence for this commitment.
resourceGovernance.ledgerLoadError: The ledger could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
resourceGovernance.ledgerPartial: Showing the newest {{count}} ledger entries. Older immutable evidence exists outside this response, so this is a partial view.
resourceGovernance.ledgerEmpty: No internal evidence has been recorded for this commitment.

changes.title: Resource change review queue
changes.description: Compare the baseline and proposal, record an independent decision, then publish against the reviewed version.
changes.loadError: Resource change requests could not be loaded.
changes.listPartial: Showing {{count}} records from the owner limit of {{limit}}. Older resource changes may exist outside this review queue.
changes.emptyDescription: New and edited commitments appear here before they can affect internal controls.
changes.newBaseline: This proposal creates the first reviewed commitment; there is no prior baseline.
changes.commercialRevisionHelp: The renewal must be PUBLISHED and belong to the selected tenant organization.
changes.noCommercialEvidence: No published commercial renewal is available for this organization. Publish the commercial renewal before requesting this commitment change.
changes.overrideExpiryHelp: Use 15 minutes to 30 days. Expiry is enforced without an external executor.
changes.justificationHelp: Explain the customer or operational reason for this reviewed change.
changes.decisionGuidance: The requester cannot decide their own change. Approval does not reserve vendor capacity or create a billing fact.
changes.selfApprovalBlocked: You requested this change. An independent resource approver must record the decision.
changes.publishGuidance: Publishing checks the exact reviewed baseline. Contract changes update the internal commitment; temporary overrides expire automatically.

lifecycle.title: Tenant retirement and purge governance
lifecycle.description: Record Retire and Purge as separate requests, verify legal-hold boundaries, and route an independently approved request to its owner service.
lifecycle.executionBoundary: Approval authorizes an internal owner handoff only. It does not retire a tenant, delete data, or clear a legal hold; owner-service evidence is still required.
lifecycle.readBoundary: Estate-read permission is required to view tenant lifecycle requests.
lifecycle.listPartial: Showing {{count}} records from the owner limit of {{limit}}. Additional tenant lifecycle requests may exist.
lifecycle.tenantCatalogUnavailable: The complete tenant catalog is unavailable. New lifecycle requests remain disabled.
lifecycle.selfDecisionBlocked: You requested or submitted this lifecycle request. A different authorized operator must record the decision.
lifecycle.createGuidance: Purge remains separate from Retire. An active global legal hold blocks the request; other hold scopes are reverified by the owner service during handoff.
lifecycle.transitionGuidance: The reason is retained as audit evidence. This transition does not execute retirement or deletion.
lifecycle.cancelGuidance: Only the request owner can cancel a current request. Cancellation ends this governance workflow and records that no owner handoff is required; it does not execute retirement or deletion.
lifecycle.completed: The tenant lifecycle governance record was saved.
lifecycle.emptyDescription: Create a Retire or Purge request when independent approval and an owner handoff need to be recorded.

artifactGovernance.externalBoundary: This control plane records artifact declarations, independent review, internal readiness, and evidence only. Registry signing, package distribution, and deployment execution are unavailable.
artifactGovernance.manifestGuidance: Declare a product artifact and compatibility policy. Keep credentials out of JSON; only secret:// references are permitted when a secret reference is necessary.
artifactGovernance.compatibilityGuidance: Record an internal compatibility assessment for {{product}} {{version}}. It is not a package-signing or runtime deployment assertion.
artifactGovernance.typedEvidenceGuidance: Schema, client, dependency, capability, and rollback evidence must use the typed structure shown below. The compatibility decision is derived from that evidence.
artifactGovernance.reviewGuidance: An independent reviewer must decide this artifact. The author cannot approve their own declaration.
artifactGovernance.planGuidance: A rollout plan can only use an independently approved, compatible artifact. READY means internally ready; it never starts deployment.
artifactGovernance.submitArtifactGuidance: Submit this compatible draft for an independent artifact review.
artifactGovernance.submitPlanGuidance: Submit this internally prepared rollout plan for an independent decision.
artifactGovernance.planDecisionGuidance: A plan requester cannot decide their own plan. This decision does not dispatch a deployment.
artifactGovernance.readyGuidance: Mark the independently approved plan internally ready. No package distribution or deployment will run.
artifactGovernance.evidenceGuidance: Record internal evidence for {{name}}. Observation evidence is fixed to NOT_DISPATCHED because no executor is connected.
artifactGovernance.completed: The internal artifact-governance record was saved.
artifactGovernance.digestHelp: Optional lowercase SHA-256 declaration. It is not a verified signature.
artifactGovernance.noEligibleArtifacts: An approved compatible artifact is required before a rollout plan can be created.
artifactGovernance.manifestListPartial: Showing {{count}} records from the owner limit of {{limit}}. Additional artifact declarations may exist, so complete-list conclusions are withheld.
artifactGovernance.planListPartial: Showing {{count}} records from the owner limit of {{limit}}. Additional rollout plans may exist, so complete-list conclusions are withheld.
artifactGovernance.reviewHistoryPartial: Showing {{count}} reviews from the owner limit of {{limit}}. Earlier review evidence remains outside this response.
artifactGovernance.evidenceHistoryPartial: Showing {{count}} evidence records from the owner limit of {{limit}}. Earlier rollout evidence remains outside this response.

typed.internalPlanBoundary: These targets, stages, and recovery steps are internal planning records. They do not represent live traffic, distribution, or deployment execution.
typed.invalidProjection: The declared structure cannot be projected safely.
typed.noRollbackDeclared: No typed recovery plan is declared.

artifactGovernance.manifestInventoryDescription: Product artifact manifests and their independent review state.
artifactGovernance.planInventoryDescription: Internal release preparation without external package distribution or execution.

emptyArtifacts.title: No artifact declarations
emptyArtifacts.description: Register a manifest before assessing compatibility and requesting review.

emptyPlans.title: No rollout plans
emptyPlans.description: Create a plan only after an artifact is independently approved and compatible.

metrics.manifestsDetail: Declared product artifacts under internal governance.
metrics.approvedDetail: Compatible artifacts cleared by a different operator.
metrics.readyDetail: Plans ready for a future external executor, not deployed.
metrics.partialDetail: Unavailable because the owner list is incomplete.

validation.schemaVersion: Manifest schema version must be a positive whole number.
validation.digest: Declared digest must be a lowercase 64-character SHA-256 value.
validation.typedCompatibility: Compatibility evidence is incomplete or does not match the typed policy structure.
validation.MANIFEST_REQUIRED: Complete the required manifest fields with a positive schema version.
validation.POLICY_REQUIRED: Complete the version, migration, and recovery policy fields.
validation.POLICY_DUPLICATE: Client and dependency keys must be unique and complete.
validation.COMPATIBILITY_INVALID: The compatibility evidence is incomplete or conflicts with the declared policy.
validation.TARGET_INVALID: Enter an environment and a whole target percentage from 1 to 100.
validation.STAGE_INVALID: Each stage needs a unique key, a whole percentage from 1 to 100, and non-negative observation minutes.
validation.STAGE_INCREASING: Stage target percentages must strictly increase.
validation.ROLLBACK_INVALID: Complete the recovery strategy, target version, data handling, and at least one validation check.
validation.EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Evidence needs a source reference, summary, and at least one validation check.

ownerFailures.operator: Operator authorization could not be verified. Governance actions are unavailable until it is reloaded.
ownerFailures.manifests: Artifact declarations could not be loaded. Cached plan data remains visible, but manifest counts and actions are unavailable.
ownerFailures.plans: Rollout plans could not be loaded. Cached artifact data remains visible, but plan counts and actions are unavailable.

artifactGovernance.independentReviewRequired: A different authorized operator must review this artifact because its author cannot decide it.
artifactGovernance.independentPlanDecisionRequired: A different authorized operator must decide this rollout plan because its requester cannot decide it.
